name: @montecarlo/desktop
description: A local-first, branchable multi-model conversation workspace.
author: Monte Carlo contributors

scripts.build: bun run prepare:convex && bun run --cwd ../web build && bun run --cwd ../runtime build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.build:dir: bun run prepare:convex && bun run --cwd ../web build && bun run --cwd ../runtime build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir
scripts.build:smoke:mac: bun run prepare:convex --platform mac --arch universal && bun run --cwd ../web build && bun run --cwd ../runtime build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --universal --dir --config.mac.identity=null --config.mac.notarize=false --config.dmg.sign=false
scripts.build:release:mac: bun run prepare:convex --platform mac --arch universal && bun run --cwd ../web build && bun run --cwd ../runtime build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --universal --publish always
scripts.typecheck: node --check src/main.cjs && node --check src/preload.cjs && node --check src/desktop-private-files.cjs && node --check src/desktop-security.cjs && node --check src/desktop-updater.cjs && node --check src/local-convex-credentials.cjs && node --check src/local-convex.cjs && node --check src/provider-secrets.cjs
